paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% compared to the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

There are 2 new news headlines in the last 24 hours, both from Bloomberg, regarding Fermi receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas. One of the headlines has a summary stating that the subpoena is for certain documents related to the project.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary and bonus eligibility. Additionally, there have been 11 new social posts in the last 24 hours, with samples including a mention of a WSJ article and a user stating they bought 15,000 shares of FRMI.
